doc.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07

title: How Billie and De De got together and married
summary: Billie tells how she told De De she liked him and how they married about 24 years ago, then travelled with Ida Cox.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives
